info.name: Skydance Media Content API (WordPress REST wp/v2) Categories API

description.content:
Skydance Media publishes skydance.com on WordPress, which exposes the WordPress REST API at https://skydance.com/wp-json/. The wp/v2 namespace is anonymously readable and returns the site's pages, media library, categories, tags and a site-wide search endpoint as JSON.

This document was DERIVED mechanically by API Evangelist from the route-discovery document served at https://skydance.com/wp-json/ on 2026-08-05 — every path, method and parameter below is taken verbatim from that descriptor. Skydance Media does not publish an OpenAPI definition of its own, and this is not a product API: it is the content API the CMS exposes. Write operations exist on these routes but require authentication (WordPress Application Passwords over HTTP Basic); anonymous callers receive HTTP 401 rest_forbidden.
